		Dataset Summary
	

Alyah (الياه in Emirati means North Star) is a manually curated evaluation benchmark for assessing the performance of Arabic large language models on the Emirati dialect. It is designed to measure not only linguistic competence, but also cultural awareness, pragmatic understanding, and sensitivity to social norms as expressed in everyday Emirati Arabic.
